name: LZR 338 275 MAX GEN2 (Lazer, 275 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, above the part number line, printed ".800 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G1 BC, below the part number line, printed ".763 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, above the part number line, printed ".394 (Oehler 89)". Marked (Oehler 89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, below the part number line, printed ".391 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .338, Grains 275, Minimum Required Twist *1-9.5", Part Number LZR 338 275 MAX GEN2, G1 BC .800 (Oehler 89) / .763 (A.B.), G7 BC .394 (Oehler 89) / .391 (A.B.), OAL 1.991", Bullet Projection 1.388"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1-2 inches faster is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.388".
